title: Does Gut-Brain Therapy Work for IBS? New Research | Nerva
summary: Gut-brain therapy helps many people manage IBS. Our new research shows it can ease anxiety, save money, and work for men and women alike.
body_markdown:
## How Nerva can help you manage IBS


Nerva is the gut-brain therapy program used by the people in all of this research. It’s a 6-week program delivered via an app, developed with gut-directed hypnotherapy researchers from Monash University, and you do it at home in 15–20 minutes a day.


Each day guides you through gut-directed hypnotherapy and short lessons that help calm the[signals between your gut and your brain](https://www.nervahealth.com/eu/post/what-is-the-gut-brain-connection) , so everyday digestion stops feeling like a five-alarm fire. In a clinical trial, 81% of people using Nerva saw a meaningful improvement in their IBS symptoms, and 71% saw meaningful improvements in managing their abdominal pain.⁵


Gut-brain therapy is recommended in major gastroenterology guidelines,⁸ and you can start it at any point in your IBS care. It’s designed to complement your medical care, not replace it. And if you finish the program and it hasn’t helped, you can request a refund.

## Frequently asked questions


### Is gut-directed hypnotherapy for IBS covered by insurance?


Insurance coverage for gut-directed hypnotherapy programs varies by plan, but many people in the US can pay with their HSA or FSA funds using a letter from their healthcare provider. If your healthcare provider refers you to Nerva, you’ll also get 25% off.


### How long do the benefits of gut-directed hypnotherapy last?


The benefits of gut-directed hypnotherapy can last well beyond the initial six-week program.⁵ Subscribing to Nerva includes the maintenance plan, so you can address any flare-ups that may arise.


### Is online gut-directed hypnotherapy as effective as seeing a hypnotherapist in person?


Gut-directed hypnotherapy done online has shown similar results to in-person sessions for easing IBS symptoms.⁹ It also skips the long waitlists and repeat appointments that make in-person therapy hard to get.


### Is gut-directed hypnotherapy safe?


Gut-directed hypnotherapy is considered very safe, with no clear side effects reported in people using it online.⁹ You stay in control the whole time, and it feels more like deep relaxation than the stage hypnosis you might see on TV.


*About this research: These studies were presented at the American College of Gastroenterology’s annual meeting in Nashville in October 2026.*
